districts.name: Eixample
districts.label: Barcelona — Eixample
districts.why: The reference build. Cerdà's grid is the densest signalised network in the set.

districts.name: Shibuya
districts.label: Tokyo — Shibuya
districts.why: One of the most heavily signalised pedestrian-vehicle conflicts anywhere; the scramble crossing is the point.

districts.name: Midtown Manhattan
districts.label: New York — Midtown Manhattan
districts.why: A near-perfect rectangular grid with avenue-length green waves -- the textbook case for signal coordination.

districts.name: Downtown & SoMa
districts.label: San Francisco — Downtown & SoMa
districts.why: Chosen over Silicon Valley: a tight signalised grid with heavy transit, where Silicon Valley is 50 km of freeway sprawl with few city signals.

districts.name: Microcentro, CABA
districts.label: Buenos Aires — Microcentro, CABA
districts.why: Dense colonial grid with very short blocks, so junction density per km2 is among the highest here.

districts.name: City & Westminster
districts.label: London — City & Westminster
districts.why: Central London core rather than Greater London: the congestion charge zone is roughly this, and it is where the signals are.
